description: Req Id: 432987 Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. Job Posting Details Position : Media Technology Analyst, Sr. (MTA), Bell Media Location : Toronto/GTHA Salary : Commensurate with qualifications and experience Job Status : Full-time Unionized Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Media Technical Analyst to join our Media Live Pipeline team. You will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our live OTT digital streaming platforms. This role involves end-to-end technical support, pipeline optimization, and deep-dive diagnostics of video encoding, packaging, and supporting CDN delivery networks. Key Responsibilities Implement, provision, test and deploy live streaming service flows in staging and production environments. Maintain, monitor, and optimize live video ingestion and transcoding pipelines (AWS Elemental, AWS MediaLive, AWS MediaPackage, AWS CloudFront, etc). Troubleshoot complex streaming issues across HLS, DASH, and SRT protocols. Collaborate with CDN partners (Fastly, Cloudfront, Akamai) to optimize video delivery and routing. Integrate and support digital rights management (DRM) and dynamic ad insertion (SSAI Live) systems. Implement and leverage telemetry and proactive monitoring systems (ELK, Grafana, CloudWatch, Various Probe solutions, etc) to track Quality of Service (QoS) and Quality of Experience (QoE). Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields — or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in digital media, broadcast engineering, or live OTT/streaming engineering and operations. Expert knowledge of video streaming standards (HLS, MPEG-DASH, CMAF) and compression codecs (H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, AV1). Practical experience and proficiency with cloud infrastructure (specifically AWS Media Services for live video). Solid script development skills (Python, Bash) for system automation including telemetry collection and correlation. Experience with Pager Duty and New Relic tools. Excellent troubleshooting skills utilizing tools such as Wireshark, Charles Proxy and AWS tools. Excellent communication and collaboration skills Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.
